origin.description: Resamples one grid onto another by cell coverage.
origin.details: Resamples one grid onto another by cell coverage.
origin.value: A raster, a number, or a matrix of polygon indexes.
origin.example:
src <- raster::raster(matrix(1:16, ncol=4), xmn=0, xmx=4, ymn=0, ymx=4)
dst <- raster::raster(xmn=0, xmx=4, ymn=0, ymx=4, nrows=2, ncols=2)
writeLines(apply(suppressWarnings(as.matrix(exact_resample(src, dst, "mean"))), 1, function(row) paste(sprintf("%.17g", row), collapse=" ")))

translation.description: Resamples one grid onto another by cell coverage.
translation.details: Resamples one grid onto another by cell coverage. A grid is an extent and a resolution, with values when the cells hold data. A polygon is WKT. Row 0 is north.
translation.value: A dict with values and an extent, a list of those, or a list of numbers.
